cases.sentence: ___ от брата, в которой говорилось, что нужно переговорить.
cases.translation: A note from his brother, saying that they needed to talk.
cases.explain: «Записка» is the subject of the clause, so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Петрицкий вынул письмо из-под ___, куда он запрятал его.
cases.translation: Petritsky pulled the letter out from under the mattress, where he had hidden it.
cases.explain: The compound preposition «из-под» (from under) governs the Genitive case, hence «матраца».

cases.translation: "Your brother was here," he said to Vronsky.
cases.explain: The verb «сказал» (said to) governs the Dative case for the addressee, hence «Вронскому».

cases.sentence: Петрицкий вынул ___ из-под матраца, куда он запрятал его.
cases.translation: Petritsky pulled the letter out from under the mattress, where he had hidden it.
cases.explain: «Письмо» is the direct object of «вынул» (pulled out), so it stands in the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: толкая за плечо уткнувшегося ___ в подушку взлохмаченного Петрицкого.
cases.translation: pushing by the shoulder the disheveled Petritsky, who was burying his nose in the pillow
cases.explain: The Instrumental case expresses the instrument of the action «уткнувшийся носом» (burying oneself nose-first), hence «носом».

cases.sentence: Вронский стоял в просторной и чистой, разгороженной надвое чухонской ___.
cases.translation: Vronsky was standing in a spacious and clean Finnish hut, divided in two.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (in) denoting location governs the Prepositional case, hence «избе».

reading.ru: Вронский стоял в просторной и чистой, разгороженной надвое чухонской избе.
reading.question: What kind of dwelling was Vronsky in?
options: A spacious, clean Finnish hut divided in two
reading.correct: A spacious, clean Finnish hut divided in two
reading.explain: The text describes a spacious, clean Finnish hut divided into two parts.

reading.ru: Петрицкий спал, когда Вронский с Яшвином вошли в избу.
reading.question: What was Petritsky doing when Vronsky and Yashvin entered?
reading.explain: The text says Petritsky was asleep when Vronsky and Yashvin entered the hut.

reading.ru: «Твой брат был здесь», — сказал он Вронскому. «Разбудил меня, черт его возьми. Сказал, что придет опять».
reading.question: Who had visited earlier and woken Petritsky up?
reading.explain: Petritsky tells Vronsky that his brother had been there and woke him up, saying he would come again.

reading.ru: Вронский действительно обещал быть у Брянского в десяти верстах от Петергофа и привезти ему за лошадей деньги, и он хотел успеть побывать и там.
reading.question: What had Vronsky promised to do regarding Bryansky?
options: Visit him ten versts from Peterhof and bring him money for horses
reading.correct: Visit him ten versts from Peterhof and bring him money for horses
reading.explain: The text says Vronsky had promised to visit Bryansky, ten versts from Peterhof, and bring him money owed for horses.

reading.ru: Но товарищи тотчас же поняли, что он не туда только едет.
reading.question: What did his comrades immediately suspect about Vronsky's trip?
options: That he was not only going to Bryansky's
That he was lying about the horses
That he would miss the race
reading.correct: That he was not only going to Bryansky's
reading.explain: His comrades immediately understood that he was not going only to Bryansky's, suspecting he was also going to see Anna.

reading.ru: Петрицкий вынул письмо из-под матраца, куда он запрятал его.
reading.question: Where had Petritsky hidden the letter?
reading.explain: Petritsky pulled the letter out from under the mattress, where he had hidden it.

reading.ru: Письмо от матери с упреками за то, что он не приезжал, и записка от брата, в которой говорилось, что нужно переговорить.
reading.question: What did the letter from Vronsky's mother contain?
reading.explain: The letter from his mother contained reproaches for his not having come to visit.

reading.ru: — Вот мои спасители! — закричал, увидав вошедших, Петрицкий, пред которым стоял денщик с водкой и огурцом на подносе.
reading.question: What did Petritsky exclaim upon seeing the newly arrived officers?
reading.explain: Petritsky shouted "Here are my saviors!" upon seeing the officers come in, with an orderly bearing vodka and a cucumber before him.

reading.ru: Волков залез на крышу и говорит, что ему грустно.
reading.question: What did Volkov do the night before, according to Petritsky's story?
options: He climbed onto the roof and said he was sad
He rode a horse into the mess hall
He sang all night in the billiard room
reading.correct: He climbed onto the roof and said he was sad
reading.explain: Petritsky recounts that Volkov climbed onto the roof and said he felt sad.

reading.ru: Он весело засмеялся, показывая свои сплошные зубы, и, надвинув фуражку на лысину, вышел и сел в коляску.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do after being teased about his balding hair?
options: He laughed cheerfully, pulled his cap over his bald spot, and got into the carriage
He got angry and stormed off
reading.correct: He laughed cheerfully, pulled his cap over his bald spot, and got into the carriage
reading.explain: The text says Vronsky laughed cheerfully, showing his even teeth, pulled his cap over his bald patch, and got into the carriage.
